The '''Treasury room''' was a chamber within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used to hold the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] assets and those of other worlds loyal to the Order.

==History==
In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] contacted the Order and asked them to hold a shipment of [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]], a very expensive substance being fought over by two [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Agreeing to have a neutral party hold the shipment until peace talks could reach a resolution, the Order silently took the vertex and locked it away within the Treasury Room. Because of this, the Council was on edge when a [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|series of robberies]] broke out within the Temple. Assigning [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]] to discover the culprit,<ref name="TCT" />

The two Masters quickly deduced that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] was behind the attacks and that a greater plot was unfolding. Sabotaging the Temple [[tech center]], Xanatos planned to break into the Treasury Room when the power in the Temple recycled. Foreseeing this line of action, Jinn and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], entered the room and waited in silence as the power shut off. When Xanatos sprung from the ventilation shaft with his accomplice [[Bruck Chun]], Jinn and Kenobi attacked with their ignited [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in hand. Xanatos quickly grabbed Chun and threatened to kill him if the Jedi approached. Kenobi feigned impatience to make Xanatos underestimate him, eventually leading to the release of Chun and a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between Dark Jedi and Jedi Master. Chun raced out of the chamber, followed by Kenobi as he charged down to the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] to complete Xanatos' plot. Meanwhile, Xanatos dueled with Jinn, eventually making their way up to the Council Chamber and eventually to the window ledge, where Xanatos escaped.<ref name="TCT" />

==Layout==
Located directly below the High Council Chamber, this circular room was only accessible to members of the High Council and secured by a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]. A short staircase led from the Council Chamber's outer hall and descended into the small hall that led to the blast door. After completing a retinal scan, the door would slide up and grant access to the vault chamber. The Treasury was directly located above the [[High Council holomap room|Operations Planning Center]].<ref name="TCT" />
